notes.title: THE HOUSE OF THE DEAD: Remake - now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Traverse the grotesque mansion once more and behold the Curien's masterpiece!

• Well known arcade classic with modern graphics and controls, including gyro aiming
• True to the original gameplay
• Local 2-player multiplayer
• Multiple endings
• Photomode
• Achievements
• Armory with unlockable weapons
• Hordes of the undead monstrosities in a new game mode
• Gallery with encountered enemies and bosses

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1694600/THE_HOUSE_OF_THE_DEAD_Remake/

tags.feature: - Well known arcade classic with modern graphics and controls, including gyro aiming
- Hordes of the undead monstrosities in a new game mode
- Gallery with encountered enemies and bosses

notes.title: We are the Plague - Patch #1 is now live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11464454/1cf537c56bf3a83530037f8e35ce3666ee9a350d.jpg[/img]

A new patch for We are the Plague on Steam is now live! We've listened to your feedback and the first batch of fixes and improvements is waiting for you - make sure your game is up to date!

PATCH NOTE:
- No more camping guys! Now the chance for a counter-attack when defending is lowered to 30% (previously 100%)
- Any collectors here? We added achievements for you!
- Check out the new snazzy summary screen with convenient improvements.
- Added some minor bug fixes


https://steamcommunity.com/app/992690/discussions/0/1652171126139342037/

notes.title: Game Patch | 24.11.2017
notes.content:
Welcome, pilots!
The newest game update for Startide is now up! In this version we implemented few tweaks and balancing into the game as well as fixes to reported bugs.

Make sure your game is up to date and don't forget to visit us on forum to leave your feedback - http://steamcommunity.com/app/598500/discussions/

[b]UPDATE[/b][list]
[*]Fixed bug with fullscreen turning off
[*]Pink bullets generator gun part is now unlocked at the begining of the game.
[*]Annihilation Ray skill unlocks earlier in the game.
[*]Voiders faction is now harder to defeat with improved stats and weapon loadouts.[/list]

[*]Annihilation Ray skill unlocks earlier in the game.

notes.title: Game Patch | 18.09.2017
notes.content:
Thank you all for your feedback, after the release week we were able to fix few issues you have encountered and add some tweaks to the game, enjoy :)

[b]UPDATE[/b][list]
[*]Fixed an issue with crashing game/dialogue not displaying properly after missions
[*]Options menu is now smaller to fit lower resolutions
[*]'Close' button in Workshop isn't covered anymore
[*]Shadows tweak in 'credits'
[*]Fixed bosses' laser sound effect
[*]Changed 'tutorial' button position to work on lower resolutions[/list]
